gloss: to become familiar with, to feel close to

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {親|した}しんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become familiar with, to become friendly with, to feel close to
definitions.explanation: To develop familiarity, affection, or comfort with something or someone over time. Often used with activities, nature, culture, or people to express a warm sense of closeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しむ。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しんできた。
examples.english: I've been familiar with music since childhood.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しまれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The festival beloved by many people will be held again this year.

notes:
USAGE:
{親|した}しむ means to feel close to or enjoy something over time. The passive form {親|した}しまれる (to be loved/enjoyed by many) is extremely common. Do not confuse with ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧ (adjective: close, intimate, friendly), though they share the same root.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しむ: to enjoy/appreciate nature
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しむ: to become familiar with culture
- {親|した}しまれる: to be loved/enjoyed (by many)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{親|した}しまれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: widely beloved
- ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親|した}しむ: to enjoy reading
